newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Macraes sees 1997 profits lower than '96.
newsitem.headline: Macraes sees 1997 profits lower than '96.

text.p: Macraes Mining said on Thursday 1997 profits would be less than in 1996, although the company was building a base for profit growth in 1999 and 2000.
In an address to the annual meeting, chairman Brettney Fogarty said, "Over the next three years we hope to lift our resources base to 10 million ounces (of gold).
"We are making good progress with the design and approvals process necessary to expand the Macraes project to a production rate of more than 300,000 ounces of gold a year".
Macraes posted a NZ$15.44 million net profit for the year to December, 1996.
